project_specification.project_name: nullius — derivatives backfill from Binance USD-M REST (funding and futbars through yesterday)
project_specification.addition_summary: The forward shadow (additions_spec_forward_shadow.xml) needs perp closes and funding through yesterday. derivs_backfill reads only Binance's public data archive, which publishes UM klines and fundingRate as monthly files. On 2026-10-14 the shadow lake's futbars and funding stopped at 2026-09-30, so the shadow book's decision date fell back to 2026-09-21. This spec adds a REST source for the funding and futbars streams. It uses the public, keyless USD-M endpoints and writes rows identical to the archive's, so the shadow job can stage every day through yesterday.

existing_context.conventions: Follow CLAUDE.md. A code map from 2026-10-14 of packages/ingest/src/nullius_ingest/derivs_backfill.py: - Spot-to-UM symbol mapping: _map_symbol / _resolve_symbol_map, with the SCALE_PREFIX "1000" contracts and their scale, cached in staging-meta/um-symbol-map.json. - _parse_funding_rows(raw_rows, filename) reads the archive CSV (calc_time, funding_interval_hours, last_funding_rate). Each day it writes funding_rate_sum, funding_rate_last and n_settlements, keyed by _day_bucket(instant), the (D 00:00, D+1 00:00] rule. - _parse_futbars_rows(raw_rows, filename, *, symbol, scale) reads the archive's kline CSV rows (Binance kline column order) and rescales fut_close, fut_volume and taker_buy_volume by the contract scale. - _day_already_written / _month_already_written skip work already done. - main(argv, *, fetch=...) takes the archive fetch as an injected callable. Tests stub it. The live REST shapes were verified on 2026-10-14: - GET https://fapi.binance.com/fapi/v1/fundingRate?symbol=S&startTime=ms&endTime=ms&limit=1000 answers [{"symbol","fundingTime" (ms; sometimes +1 ms past the settlement, e.g. 1791936000001),"fundingRate" (decimal string), "markPrice","rateType"}], ascending. - GET https://fapi.binance.com/fapi/v1/klines?symbol=S&interval=1d&startTime=ms&endTime=ms&limit=1500 answers arrays in the archive kline column order. - Neither needs a key.

category.name: Ingest
category.feature: System backfills the funding and futbars streams from Binance's public USD-M REST API, so that a lake can be staged through yesterday instead of through the last published monthly archive file. - derivs_backfill gains `--source {archive,rest}`. The default is archive, which is unchanged. With rest: - only the funding and futbars streams are allowed; metrics is refused with a clear error - the spot-to-UM symbol mapping uses the same SCALE_PREFIX rule against GET /fapi/v1/exchangeInfo's symbols, not the archive crawl - Funding comes from GET /fapi/v1/fundingRate, paginated by startTime and endTime with limit 1000, over [--first 00:00, --last+1 00:00]. - Each fundingTime is floored to the whole second before _day_bucket, so a settlement 1 ms past midnight lands on the day whose window it closes, as the archive's calc_time does. - The rows then go through the same per-day aggregation (funding_rate_sum, funding_rate_last, n_settlements). - Futbars come from GET /fapi/v1/klines with interval 1d, paginated, through the same parsing and scale rescaling as _parse_futbars_rows. - A candle whose close time is in the future (today's open candle) is never written. - The written partitions are byte-for-byte what the archive path writes for the same days, apart from source provenance if that is recorded. The skip rules are respected per day. - HTTP is injected the way the archive fetch already is. Requests are polite (a sleep between pages). A 429 or 418 response is retried with backoff, and other HTTP errors fail that symbol's job (counted in the summary line's failed). - deploy/shadow/shadow_daily.sh step 2 passes --source rest for funding,futbars. Metrics, when SHADOW_METRICS=1, stays on the archive. Nothing else in the script changes. - test_derivs_rest.py, with recorded responses in fixtures/derivs_rest/rest_responses.json, covers: - pagination - the +1 ms fundingTime bucketing - one day built both ways equals the archive parse of the same settlements and candles, field by field - 1000-contract rescaling - the open candle is skipped - metrics is refused under rest - 429 backoff It passes under pytest-xdist. The ingest member suite passes.
